_about: Round 14 (2026-11-25): film-style layered effects and the pro mix, asked for by Anthony ('do 3 and 5, and 6 for now'). Stable Audio as the effects generator is added to the same page when its model is available. Earlier rounds are in variants_round*.json.

variants.label: Layered effects
variants.why: Film style. Each key moment is built from its main sound plus a lead-in whoosh and a small detail made separately, and one quiet steady background of the room runs under the whole video and across the cuts.

variants.label: Layered effects, layers further back
variants.why: The same layers, with the supporting sounds and the room background 4 to 6 dB quieter, in case the first one feels busy.

variants.label: Pro mix
variants.why: Broadcast-style finishing: rumble filtered out, one steady gain to streaming loudness with a true-peak limiter. This video has no talking, so the part that keeps dialogue clear cannot be heard here; expect it to sound very close to Current.

variants.label: Layered effects with the pro mix
variants.why: Both changes together: what the new default would be.

variants.label: Stable Audio effects
variants.why: Same plan from Claude, but every sound is made from its description by Stable Audio (licensed worldwide) and placed at its planned time, instead of the current model that watches the clip. Every sound is its own clip.

variants.label: Stable Audio effects, layered
variants.why: Stable Audio for every sound, plus the film-style layers: whoosh and detail on key moments and a steady room background.
